rulings.evidence: Reduced sodium is a label variant of the same bottle at the same shelf price - the 2026-08-26 'less sodium soy sauce' -> soy-sauce precedent, cos 0.89. Board 7 of 7; no gram or price change, so not a real form flip.
Tap water for the teriyaki sauce: nothing is bought and it contributes no macros - the 2026-08-26 'cold water' precedent. Kept on the line list so the method reads.
Light vs dark is the same bagged product at the same price - the 2026-08-26 'dark brown sugar' ruling. Refused the board's plain sugar match: different food, different gram weight per Tbsp.

The form flag is a wording artefact - the vocabulary row's own name carries the boneless/skinless words (source's typo 'bonless' aside). Board 7 of 7, and the source states the weight, so no each-weight assumption is involved.

rulings.raw: 1 medium zucchini (, diced into half moons and quartered (1 1/2 cups))
rulings.evidence: Exact same-form vocabulary row, board 6 of 7. One medium zucchini is 196 g, which cross-checks against the source's own 1 1/2 cups diced.

Matchstick is a knife cut of a whole carrot, same food and same gram weight, and carrots is 7 of 7. Refused shredded-carrots: shredded is a different bagged cut and the vocabulary itself flags it as a different form.
Florets cut from a fresh crown are the same food as broccoli (7 of 7); refused frozen-broccoli-florets, since fresh-to-frozen is the standing form-flip rejection.

rulings.raw: 1 1/2 - 2 cups white or brown rice (, cooked according to directions on package (I prefer short grain brown rice))
rulings.evidence: Exact same-form vocabulary row Rice [rice], board 7 of 7; either-or line and both are the same bagged dry rice price class. Weighed as 1 3/4 cups DRY (185 g/cup), the mid-range of the source's own 1 1/2 to 2 cups.

Explicitly optional garnish. Toasted vs plain is a roast within one spice-jar SKU at the same price class (the 'ground oregano' -> dried-oregano reasoning), and toasted-sesame-seeds is the board's live 6 of 7 id; a null here would leave a priced jar unpriced for no gain.
